commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

original.comparator: registered identity or named-value statement versus concise complete careful English
original.population: 32 complete pairs over eight declared identity systems, equal relation weights, two identifier variants
original.aggregation: equal pair mean then maximum tokenizer mean; retain each relation separately

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Token cost difference (Δ tokens) of the registered Ainglish identity and named-value forms versus their complete careful-English mappings, measured as literal encoded length on cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base over 32 wholly fresh complete-statement pairs across the eight declared identity systems (16 identity, 16 value, equal relation weights, two identifier variants); reduced as the equal-pair mean per tokenizer, then the least favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean. Direction lower_better, neutral 0, reported as the worst-tokenizer floor.
admissibility_gates: every pair carries both arms non-empty
items_sha256 equals the filed fresh digest 79a4f7b5665871e94b94d36a8fe95fd16bed22a014cfaf525ebe683ad938e603
items_sha256 differs from the source digest 589e36bec71f153542fd2de0caa0a44a4fe4c1ce7c176a70e8475a14fe92a2f9
all three encodings load under tiktoken 0.14.0
no source item string reused (identifiers are freshly derived)
abort rather than file if any gate fails
